events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music television actually played music videos? On this day in 1981, MTV launched, forever changing the landscape of music. The first video? An ironically prophetic one from The Buggles...

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' upon the world. It wasn't just an album; it was a statement. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a generation gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. An iconic moment in history that still resonates today. Which legendary performance stands out for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Elvis Presley, who left us in 1977. His music and influence continue to shape generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur, an influential rapper, died on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996. His powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop culture are still felt today. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970, in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Celebrating Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: On this day in 1970, we lost the legendary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work and electrifying performances continue to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' and that unforgettable album cover. Still inspiring pilgrimages to that zebra crossing! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Rock 'n' roll royalty Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today! The voice and force behind The Pretenders, she's still as cool as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! The one and only Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was first issued in the UK on October 24, 1975, to promote the compilation 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the acclaimed actor, comedian, and writer known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your standout track from the double LP?
